name: Kagamishita Mizuka
source:
She has a calm personality and is very protective of her son, Takuma. 

In fact, she has more than parent-child feelings for Takuma, which she suppresses with her rational mind.

However, when Takuma gets a girlfriend, she begins to push for a sexual relationship with him.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apadash/aptd_023.html#char]official site[/url]]
